clips.title: The story
paras: Pozzik will be busy fitting the new fuel regulator into the racer designs, but suggests that you help the team further by speaking with Razzeric on the Shimmering Flats. Razzeric is the team's pilot, its eighteenth, and likes to add modifications to the racers.

Pozzik says the fuel regulator is keeping him busy, but you can help the team some more by talking to Razzeric on the Shimmering Flats. Razzeric is the team's pilot, its eighteenth in fact, and likes to add little modifications of his own to the racers. Pozzik adds that Razzeric is a little off his rocker, so you should try not to seem too surprised.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'm going to be busy with working on integrating this new fuel regulator to our racer designs, but if you'd like to help out the team some more, talk to Razzeric. He's our pilot--well, our eighteenth pilot, to be exact--and he likes to add his own little modifications to the racers.
He's a little off his rocker, though, so try not to act too surprised.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You're the traveler that's been helping Pozzik out, right? I was like you once, running around the pit area, helping with whatever work the mechanics would let me do.
Now look at me! The goblin racing team's pilot extraordinaire!
